summary: PTCT is a fundamentally complicated but HONESTLY DISCLOSED distressed name. The -43% drawdown is anchored on a real, specific, deterministic regulatory cliff (EC adoption of CHMP negative opinion on Translarna EEA conditional authorization), not on accounting deception or balance-sheet fragility. The 10-K and Q1 10-Q both disclose the cliff, quantify the at-risk revenue, and acknowledge that EC adoption is overdue at cutoff. Honesty-alpha verdict: PTCT discloses bad news rather than obscuring it (auditor clean E&Y 14-year tenure, no going-concern, $885M liquidity, restructuring executed, sepiapterin Phase 3 hit, insider buying not selling, impairment booked on discontinued programs). The lying-detector framework should treat PTCT as a LONG-tier candidate — the market is pricing pre-known disclosed risk, not hidden fraud.
